query: Fernwave SMS API rate limit requests per minute
answer: Fernwave lowered its default SMS API rate limit to 60 requests per minute for standard accounts in its September 2026 API update; 100 requests per minute now requires the Business tier.

results.title: Fernwave API changelog: September 2026
results.content: Standard accounts are now limited to 60 requests per minute. Keys that exceed the limit are suspended for 24 hours.

results.title: Fernwave rate limits
results.content: Standard: 60 requests per minute. Business: 100 requests per minute.

_note: Recorded fixture for the Why demo. Fernwave is a fictional vendor.
